title: Operations Executive
why_it_fits: Customer Support match. 3 skills: excel, word, customer support. Likely PH eligibility signal

position_overview: Job Description We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive Operations Executive to join our team. Thecandidate will be responsible for monitoring transactions, handling client queries, coordinating with internal teams, and ensuring smooth transaction processing and client support. Key Responsibilities Monitor, verify, and approve transactions as per company process and compliance requirements Handle client queries related to transaction status, delays, failed payments, and beneficiary fund receipt issues Coordinate with internal teams and banking partners for transaction investigations and resolutions Respond to clients professionally through email and other communication channels Send regular transaction status updates and follow-up emails to clients Maintain and update Excel/MIS sheets for all client queries, complaints, transactions issues, and resolutions Ensure all client issues are tracked, resolved, and properly documented Escalate critical or unresolved cases to the respective teams promptly Maintain accuracy, confidentiality, and operational efficiency in daily activities Requirements Bachelors degree in B.Com, BBA, BBM, BA, MBA, or any banking/finance-related field Freshers are welcome to apply Good verbal and written communication skills in English Basic knowledge of banking, remittance, payment operations, or financial services preferred intermediary or Proficiency in MS Excel and basic computer applications Strong attention to detail and problem-solving skills Ability to manage multiple tasks and work in a fast-paced environment Preferred Skills Experience in customer support, banking operations, or payment processing is an added advantage Understanding of transaction monitoring and compliance processes preferred Good coordination and follow-up skills Please mention the word **LIBERATE** and tag RMTMwLjEzMS4yMDAuNTQ= when applying to show you read the job post completely (#RMTMwLjEzMS4yMDAuNTQ=). This is a beta feature to avoid spam applicants. Companies can search these words to find applicants that read this and see they're human.
